_comment: The line of the day. One declarative, generated from the leading aspect.
This is the notification, built before the notifications exist. Roadmap
task 1.5 puts it here on purpose: a push payload that has been read on a
page for months is one somebody has already caught the bad sentences in,
and a bad sentence on a lock screen is the one people uninstall over.
So it is held to the constraints of a push rather than the constraints of
a card. 72 characters, because that is roughly what a lock screen shows
before it truncates. No area label above it and no measurement below it,
because a notification carries neither. It has to stand up alone.
Keyed area by tone, the same address the card headline uses, but written
to a different brief: the headline sits under a label that says which
area it is about, and this does not, so it has to carry that itself.
check-voice.mjs enforces the 72 characters and the no-question rule on
this file the same way it does on readings.json.

self.charged: Something you did quietly is about to be seen. Let it be seen plainly.
self.open: The room is easier to enter today than you are expecting it to be.
self.friction: How you land and how you meant to land are not the same today.
self.easy: You are being read accurately today. Say the thing you mean.
self.pull: Who you are and what is wanted are at opposite ends of today.

money.charged: Say the number out loud today, and say the one you rounded down.
money.open: Somebody says yes to a figure today. Ask for the whole of it.
money.friction: The expense you are avoiding costing out is the one to cost out.
money.easy: Your effort is worth more today than usual. Point it somewhere.
money.pull: You cannot have both prices today. Choose the one you would defend.

talk.charged: The sentence lands harder than you mean it to today. Send it anyway.
talk.open: Introduce two people today. It costs nothing and it compounds.
talk.friction: The short reply is the right one today. Do not explain twice.
talk.easy: The long conversation goes well today. Have it while it is going.
talk.pull: What you are saying and what is heard are pulling apart today.

home.charged: Home is louder than usual today, and it is not asking politely.
home.open: A small thing at home is worth fixing today. Just the small one.
home.friction: Not everything at home wants fixing today. Leave one of them.
home.easy: The house is on your side today. Cook for somebody in it.
home.pull: Where you are from and where you sleep are pulling apart today.

making.charged: Make the thing badly today, on purpose, and finish it that way.
making.open: The idea is available today. It will not be this cheap in a week.
making.friction: The work resists today. Do the unglamorous half of it instead.
making.easy: It comes out clean today. Point that at the thing that was stuck.
making.pull: Making it and showing it are pulling in different directions today.

work.charged: Something you have built quietly gets looked at today. Let it.
work.open: Take the meeting slightly above your level today. Ask for it.
work.friction: The wall at work is real today. Stop testing it and go around.
work.easy: Your effort converts today. Point it at the stuck thing.
work.pull: What you do and what you are known for are not the same today.

love.charged: Say the direct thing to them today. The softened version will not land.
love.open: The difficult conversation goes better today than it will tomorrow.
love.friction: You are not going to win this one today. Try not needing to.
love.easy: Warmth is cheap today. Spend it on the person, not on the plan.
love.pull: What you want and what they want are at opposite ends of today.

sex.charged: What you keep below the surface is close to it today.
sex.open: Say the thing you were going to keep. It is easier to hear today.
sex.friction: Withholding is a decision too, and it is the expensive one today.
sex.easy: You can go a long way down today without it costing the climb back.
sex.pull: What you will not let go of and what will not stay is today.

belief.charged: Something you believed is being tested today. Let it be tested.
belief.open: The far-off thing is closer today. Look at it properly.
belief.friction: Do not argue the big thing today. Argue the small true one.
belief.easy: The generous reading is also the accurate one today.
belief.pull: What you hold true and what you can show are pulling apart today.
